@startuml

class Product {
  + Name : string
  + Description : string
  + NetPrice : double
  + Manufacturer : string
  + CountryOfManufacture : string
}

class VATRate {
  + CountryCode : string
  + Rate : double
  + Currency : string
  + EuroConversionRate : double
}

class Representative {
  + FirstName : string
  + LastName : string
  + SocialSecurityNumber : string
  + TelephoneNumber : string
  + EmailAddress : string
  + CountryResponsible : string
}

class Customer {
  + Name : string
  + Address : string
  + TelephoneNumber : string
  + EmailAddress : string
  + CountriesReselling : List<string>
}

class Order {
  + OrderID : int
  + Product : Product
  + Quantity : int
  + OrderDate : datetime
  + DesiredDeliveryDate : datetime
}

Product "1" -- "0..*" VATRate
Representative "1" -- "1" Country
Customer "1" -- "*" Representative
Order "1" -- "1" Product

@enduml
